summary: Four blocking findings, all in P1: the "one source of truth per leaf" constraint is unsatisfiable by any route the repo offers today, the serialization invariant ignores the equally-serialized OpenBao converge path, serial: 1 silently forfeits the per-host independence the cited prior art protects, and the stalled-renewer Prometheus signal P1 and V15 rest on is recorded as deferred.
